geuh5u.description_en:
Need somebody handy with tools to pop over to [LOCATION] and help out with some repairs. Our last repair guy knocked out most of the fixes but there's still some stuff that could use looking at.
I think if you've got six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to patch up around five pipes, you should be covered.
Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the “Guide to Maintenance” in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Hockrow Agency
Case File #BR56263
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
Need an operative to extract the blackbox from a destroyed ship. The ship’s owner claims that it was genuinely lost in an outlaw attack, but the insurance company has doubts. We’ve been hired to find out which is true.
I suspect that the perpetrators are long gone by now, so you shouldn't run into any resistance.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Proceed to [LOCATION], secure the black box in the derelict spaceship there and return it to [DESTINATION].
Additional Notes:

补充说明：
这次任务你需要进行舱外活动，所以一定要穿上宇航服。

RE: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous
WORK BRIEF:
There's been another attack out at [LOCATION]. Whoever did it killed the entire crew in the ambush. The Governing Committee wants answers so we're looking for someone to head out there, retrieve the blackbox and deliver it [DESTINATION]. Make sure you bring a ship with some storage to hold the blackbox.
Be incredibly careful. They said it was a large group that attacked them, and I'd bet they're still in the area.
PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

zr39a7.description_en:
IN-GAME ALSO SHOWN AS
Turning the Tables
Upgrade Grab
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.
Head to [LOCATION] and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.
Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION] and then we'll send over the creds.
-Bit Zeros
zr39a7.description_zh:
好不容易才锁定一件稀有科技，结果却在最后一秒被人截胡。追踪它倒是不难，但我可不想一直追着这东西跑。

去 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 把它给我找回来。那边的人估计压根不知道那玩意儿有多贵重，不如我们帮他们一把，顺手把东西拿走。至于有没有人看守，我也不清楚，怎么应对潜在威胁你自己看着办。

拿到手后，把它送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>，到时候我们就给你打信用点。

- 零比特

fesblg.description_en:
Hello,
Some sad news. Unfortunately our hauler ran into some trouble and had to abandoned the cargo they were due to deliver. We haven't heard anything back from them so we're assuming the worse.
We're in the process of contacting their family and are conscious this is a very sensitive time, but also can't afford to leave a job incomplete. Our trackers show the cargo is still intact over at [LOCATION].
If you could finish the delivery we would be really grateful. We're not picking up on any nearby ships so it should be safe for you to collect. Bring a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Deliver the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll take care of the rest.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

我们正在联系他们的家人，也明白现在是特别敏感的时刻，但实在没法放着任务半途而废。我们的追踪器显示，那批货物还在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 那儿，完好无损。

要是你能把这批货送完，我们真的非常感激。目前没探测到附近有别的飞船，应该挺安全的，你去取就行。记得带把<EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>，再开一艘能装得下 <EM4>[MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱</EM4>的船。

把货送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 那儿的货运电梯就行，剩下的交给我们来处理。

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递

玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

Got some asshole’s trying to push us out of the system. You up for pushing back?

1uihxr8.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Our research team at at [DESTINATION] is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments.
We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.
The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

33lmg9.description_en:
Hey There,
My name is Braden Corchado and I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system. I may have reached out already, but we try to make it a point of approaching anyone who meets our high standards and encouraging them to complete a pro tem contract.
You can't do much better than become a Northrock contractor. We have a solid reputation for offering challenging and interesting work at a higher rate of pay then many of our competitors in system.
Now, to get approved, you will need to apprehend one [TARGET]. They have recently escaped from the detention center and your job will be to track them down before they can disappear completely off the grid.
A little hint is that it's safe to assume that the target is going to go try to clear their record. I recommend triangulating your search between the detention center they escaped from and locations where they can hack into the record system.
Get this done and we'll see about getting you more work.
Hope to hear from you soon,
Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

成为北境之岩的承包商绝对是你的不二之选。我们良好的声誉能为你提供一些既有趣又不乏挑战性的工作，且报酬高于星系内的其它竞争者。

如果，你想获得认证的话，你需要去抓捕 <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>。他们最近刚从拘留中心里逃出来，而你的工作就是在他们消声灭迹前，把他们抓回去。

有些线索能帮得上忙，可以假设他们此时应该赶着要去清除记录，我建议你在拘留中心的位置，和他们有机会能骇入记录系统的地方进行下三角定位。

希望尽快收到你的答复，

布雷登·科查多

1d28wif.description_en:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.
We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a [TARGET] and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by [LOCATION], which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right.
Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.
And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus 8 Council Scrip to sweeten the pot.
Stows out.

更重要的是，我还会额外奖励给主承包商 <EM4>[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证</EM4> 作为甜头。

- 斯托斯

8j77k7.description_en:
Hey,
Just our luck that we land one of the biggest contracts of our life and our hauler's engines seize up. They've tried their best to fix it but seems like it's just not happening.
Can you fly out to [LOCATION] and grab the cargo for us? It's really important that we show our client that we're just as reliable as the other big players out there.
Just so you know this is a large shipment. You'll need a ship that can handle [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to move it all. Once you've transferred it to your ship, deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll send confirmation to the client.
Considering the circumstances, we're paying above market rates to whoever can complete this.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
8j77k7.description_zh:
嘿，

真够背的，我们刚拿下这辈子最大的一单，结果运输船引擎直接卡死了。他们拼了命修，但看样子还是没戏了.

你能飞去 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 帮我们把货带回来吗？这事儿真挺关键的，客户得看到我们跟那些大厂一样靠谱。

顺便说下，这单货量不小，你得开艘能装下 <EM4>[MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱</EM4>的大船，再带上一个<EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>才搬得动。等你把货挪到自己船上，直接送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 那儿的货运电梯就行，我们立马给客户发确认。

考虑到现状，谁能干完这个活，我们给的钱绝对比市场价高不少。

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递

玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

Care to help us ghost a bad guy?

1grzmx5.description_en:
Hi,
Looks like Orison needs another resupply of processed food and pressurized ice. They have this stuff on a standard delivery schedule but they just requested a shipment as soon as possible.
Are you available to make the run? The stuff (4 SCU containers or smaller) is waiting to be picked up from a freight elevator at [LOCATION]. Should be a quick and easy run for you to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
1grzmx5.description_zh:
嗨，

看起来奥里森需要在补给一次加工食品和加压冰。他们有一个标准的交货时间表，但他们只是要求尽快发货。

你有空去跑这趟吗？这批东西（尺寸不超过 <EM4>[MAX_SCU]</EM4> 的集装箱）正在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 的货运电梯上等着被取走。对你来说应该能轻松又简单地送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的货运电梯。

顺便提醒，我们强烈建议承包商随身携带<EM4>手持式牵引光束</EM4>。

[SIGN_OFF]

蔡斯·休伊特
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”

科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。
